SELECT json_build_object(
  'politicas', (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('tabela', tablename, 'nome', policyname, 'cmd', cmd, 'using', left(qual, 220))) FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename IN ('campaign_leads', 'lead_history') AND cmd IN ('DELETE', 'UPDATE', 'ALL')),
  'papeis', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (
     SELECT c.name AS empresa, coalesce(ur.role::text, 'sem papel') AS papel, uc.role AS papel_empresa, count(*) n
     FROM user_companies uc JOIN companies c ON c.id = uc.company_id
     LEFT JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = uc.user_id
     WHERE c.name IN ('Castelo da Diversão','Mega Magic','Planeta Divertido','Aventura Kids')
     GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1) x),
  'permissoes_negadas', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (
     SELECT permission, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT granted) AS negadas, count(*) FILTER (WHERE granted) AS liberadas
     FROM user_permissions WHERE permission LIKE 'leads.%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1) x),
  'exclusoes_30d', (SELECT count(*) FROM lead_history WHERE action ILIKE '%exclu%' AND created_at > now() - interval '30 days'),
  'historico_sem_empresa', (SELECT count(*) FROM lead_history WHERE company_id IS NULL)
) AS r
